summary: Adds plate_core/release.py with get_release_status and get_release_notes_diff, plus CLI (gh plate release status/notes) and MCP (plate_release_status/plate_release_notes) surfaces.
migration_impact: New gh plate release status and gh plate release notes subcommands are available. Two new MCP tools (plate_release_status, plate_release_notes) are registered. Feature detection gains release-branch and release-notes-layout flags.
migration_guidance: 1. Pull the updated src/plate_core/release.py, cli.py, mcp_server.py, and features.py into your repo.
2. The new CLI subcommand is: gh plate release status [--repo ...] [--json]
3. The new CLI subcommand is: gh plate release notes [--from X] [--to Y] [--json]
4. Two new MCP tools are registered: plate_release_status and plate_release_notes.
5. gh plate features now reports release-branch and release-notes-layout flags.
6. No migration needed for existing functionality — all additions are additive.
agent_notes: Use gh plate release status to inspect the current release state before opening a Release PR. Use gh plate release notes --from X --to Y to understand what changed between PLATE versions. Both commands support --json for machine-readable output.
